findings.title: Input hashing crashes on tracked files deleted from the working tree
findings.message: `git ls-files --cached` also lists tracked files that were deleted in the working tree. `sha(root / p)` then raises FileNotFoundError. The crash happens after the exclusive `.qualification-started` marker is written, so the evidence directory is permanently burned and no qualification record is produced.
findings.suggestion: Skip paths that are not regular files when hashing, so a deleted tracked file cannot abort a run after the exclusive marker is written.
findings.evidence: return {p: sha(root / p) for p in paths}

fix.before: return {p: sha(root / p) for p in paths}
fix.after: return {p: sha(root / p) for p in paths if (root / p).is_file()}

findings.title: Unchecked type assertion on editor widget can panic during capture
findings.message: capture() runs during layout measurement and asserts `edit.widget` is a `*core.TextField` without checking. If the editing record's widget is another type, or is nil during a transitional state such as retirement or replacement, this panics and takes down the measurement path for the whole grid. `edit.widget` is typed as an interface elsewhere, which is why the assertion is needed at all.
findings.suggestion: Use the comma-ok form and skip filling `m.Editor` when the assertion fails: `if field, ok := edit.widget.(*core.TextField); ok && field != nil { ... }`.
